summary_1line: Vyasa reveals the divine origins of the warriors and summons the slain heroes from the Ganges for a miraculous reunion with the living.

image_candidates.scene_text: From the moonlit waters of the Ganges, Bhishma, Drona, Karna, and countless armored warriors rise shining in celestial garments.
Blind Dhritarashtra receives divine sight from Vyasa and beholds his fallen sons standing radiant before him.
Crowds of grieving families watch in awe as the battlefield dead emerge from the river amid music of Gandharvas and garlands of Apsaras.
